sources.title: AI Video Checker - Free Check if a Video Is AI-Generated
sources.snippet: AI Video Check analyses a short video file or a public link and estimates how likely the content was produced by an AI video model. It does this by extracting a group of technical, visual and temporal signals from the uploaded material and comparing them with patterns that are typical for synthetic clips. The result is shown as a probability score plus, when possible, a guess of AI-generator, .
